description: The District Census Handbook is a publication of India's census organisation since 1951, and for the 2011 census it is published for every district in the Census Digital Library. Part XII A, the Village and Town Directory, records for each village and town the infrastructure facilities available: education, medical, drinking water, communication and transport, post and telegraph, electricity, banking and other facilities; the catalogue entry of each handbook offers state-wide Village Amenities and Town Amenities spreadsheets (XLSX) besides the PDF. Part XII B holds the Primary Census Abstract, with population and the household amenities collected in the first phase of the census, the Houselisting and Housing Census. The handbooks are produced by the state Directorates of Census Operations for the Registrar General and Census Commissioner. Coverage: all districts of India at village, town and ward level. Format and access: XLSX, PDF and zipped inset tables, free to download from the NADA catalogue without login. Licence: not stated beyond rights held by ORGI. Caveats: the data describe 2011; the gazette notifications in the library set the first (houselisting) phase of the next census for 1 April to 30 September 2026, so newer results are not out; the directory mixes census and non-census administrative data; the censusindia.gov.in server omits its intermediate TLS certificate, so some clients fail to connect unless the issuer certificate is added. Simulation uses: village-level presence of power, water, roads, transport and health facilities for rural infrastructure access and exposure models. Related records: the Census of India 2011 houselisting tables and IPUMS International census microdata.
